Meta.title: Roompire
Meta.description: Approval-based shared-house expenses, ledger, FX locks, and calendar operations.

Landing.headline: Roommate expenses become approval-ready obligations, not spreadsheet rumors.
Landing.body: Track proposals, locked FX, formal debts, settlements, chores, recurring bills, and audit history in one bilingual PWA.
Landing.workflowBody: Submit an expense, lock the historical rate, collect debtor approval, mature only approved shares, and keep the ledger append-only.
Landing.calendarPreview: Rent and chores stay on the same household calendar
Landing.proofOne: Pending proposals stay out of balances
Landing.proofTwo: zh-CN and en-US ship from MVP
Landing.proofThree: Desktop and mobile flows are tested in browser

Dashboard.title: USC 3B2B operations
Dashboard.subtitle: Approval queue, formal balances, calendar work, and audit signals for the household.
Dashboard.proposalQueueHint: Drafts and pending shares do not affect the formal ledger.
Dashboard.formalBalancesHint: Only approved shares and confirmed settlements appear here.
Dashboard.calendarHint: Bills, chores, group events, and repayment deadlines.
Dashboard.auditHint: Important state changes are recorded with actor and timestamp.
Dashboard.emptyBalanceHint: Create and approve a proposal before balances change.
Dashboard.pendingProposalMeta: USD 120.00 split equally, expense date Jul 1

Identity.devSessionHint: Switch local test users without leaving the browser.
Identity.householdAccessHint: Membership and roles are loaded from PostgreSQL.
Identity.createHouseholdHint: New households create owner membership, default categories, and an audit event.
Identity.householdSettingsHint: Owners and admins can update locale, timezone, settlement currency, and approval policy.
Identity.memberDirectoryHint: Only active household members can view this list.
Identity.inviteMemberHint: Owners and admins can create expiring invite codes.
Identity.acceptInviteHint: Paste an invite code to join a household as the current user.
Identity.memberManagementHint: Owners and admins can update roles or remove members while preserving audit history.
Identity.cannotInvite: Only owners and admins can invite members.
Identity.cannotManageMembers: Only owners and admins can manage member roles.
Identity.apiBoundaryHint: The page uses the same membership checks as the REST endpoints.
